title: A proof of Erdős's B+B+t conjecture
review_note: The correspondence construction retains a topological generic point. A continuous Kronecker-factor extension and a disintegrated progression joining give support/genericity statements, with the support-density step using Lusin and Borel–Cantelli. An Erdős progression yields an infinite restricted pair-sum set recursively. B remains a subset of A and diagonal pairs are excluded. The published theorem allows positive upper Banach density and natural shifts; the Lean target is the ordinary-density instance requested by Problem 656. Full-text reading is not a claim of complete independent mathematical proof verification.
relevance: Primary proof of the exact Problem 656 conclusion; its stronger upper-Banach-density hypothesis implies the ordinary-density instance reproduced in Lean.
